name: Orchestrator
tagline: Runs a timed morning pipeline of research bots that ends in a reviewed trading brief.
description: A supervisor for a small bot workforce whose daily product is a research brief, not a trade. Pre-open intelligence runs first, a second pass argues the opposite case, and the morning report ships only after a quality check. Roles sit on separate cards, handoffs move between rooms, and each stage runs against a clock.
author: keepclmcarryong
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
